premises.text: Mobile gaming technology has advanced significantly, allowing for interactive gaming anywhere.
premises.evidence_span: what mobile gaming meant, people would be pretty amazed back then to think we have basically the power of a supercomputer in our pocket

premises.text: LightShot allows for interactive gaming through a sensor-based platform.
premises.evidence_span: we are LightShot, a sensor-based mobile gaming platform that allows completely interactive gaming anywhere in the world

premises.text: Players can engage in real-life games using the LightShot system.
premises.evidence_span: everybody's assigned another player who they have to hunt down

premises.text: The platform supports game development by allowing users to create their own games and peripherals.
premises.evidence_span: you're able to develop your own games and your own peripherals

premises.text: The platform is cloud-based, leveraging the power of users' phones for gaming.
premises.evidence_span: we've developed here is a totally cloud-based platform

premises.text: The system automates gameplay, eliminating the need for a game master.
premises.evidence_span: no longer do you need a game master for each of these interactive-type games

premises.text: Real-time stats and health information can be displayed to players during gameplay.
premises.evidence_span: you can see all of your in-game stats, your health, your any type of game information that you have as part of the gameplay

premises.text: The platform fosters a community for third-party game developers.
premises.evidence_span: we are developing this as an open community and hosting the third-party game developers

value.text: Players can enjoy interactive gaming experiences that utilize real-world environments.
value.evidence_span: we're trying to get people to play mobile games without sitting there staring at this tiny little screen

notes: Kickstarter campaign announcement is excluded as traction.
